summary: Ford Motor Credit Company LLC filed an 8-K reporting the issuance and sale of €750,000,000 aggregate principal amount of 4.480% Notes due July 8, 2031 under its existing shelf registration statement on Form S-3. This is a routine debt offering (a shelf takedown) with no equity conversion, tender offer, or change-of-control implications. The filing includes the legal opinion of counsel David J. Witten on the notes' legality and provides standard exhibits. No special-situation elements—such as an acquisition, divestiture, spin-off, or restructuring—are present. The event is a conventional capital markets transaction by an auto finance captive, not a special situation.
